💼 INTERNSHIP ALERT: Florida Blue / GuideWell — IT Summer 2027 Internship (Jacksonville, FL · Hybrid)

If you're looking for a summer 2027 internship, put this one high on your list. I've interviewed with Florida Blue before, and it's a genuinely great place to learn — real projects, a mentor on your track's team, and face time with leadership all the way up to the CIO (you present to the CIO + Tech VPs at the end of the program). The experience you can pick up here is legit.

🎯 You pick a track. A few that stand out for us:

• Infrastructure — Linux, OpenShift, and Kubernetes. If you want to be a platform engineer, this is a perfect stepping stone. OpenShift is Red Hat's platform, so this track lines up directly if your goal is somewhere like IBM or Red Hat down the road. Most people in the club could do really well here.

• Cybersecurity — work alongside real red-team and blue-team members on actual security challenges. Security+/Network+/A+/Linux+ (done or in progress) is preferred. If security is your thing, tap in.

• Also offered: Generative AI, Cloud Engineering (AWS/Azure), Data Analytics, Data Science, Application Development, and Business Analyst.

📋 The basics:
• Location: Jacksonville, FL (Hybrid)
• Pay: $24–$38/hr
• GPA 3.0+, able to commit ~30 hrs/week
• Open to juniors, seniors, and grad students (there's a separate Graduate IT Internship posting too — grab that one if you're in a master's program)
• Job ID: 42181 · posted 10/07

📢 Job Opportunity | Carrier Digital Technology Leadership Program (DTLP)

Carrier Global just opened applications for their 2027 Digital Technology Leadership Program — a two-year rotational program for recent grads in cybersecurity, MIS, CS, data science, or business analytics.

What it is:
Three 8-month rotations across Carrier's Digital org — covering areas like cybersecurity, data & AI, infrastructure, enterprise systems, and digital products. You're not stuck in one lane; you rotate and build a broad foundation while getting real ownership of projects.

Why rotational programs are worth your time:
Most entry-level roles lock you into one team, one stack, one type of work for years. Rotational programs fast-track your growth by exposing you to multiple business units, leadership, and problem sets in a compressed timeframe. By the time you're done, you have the network, the context, and the credibility that most people spend 5+ years trying to build.

Basic requirements:
- Bachelor's in cybersecurity, CS, MIS, data science, or business analytics
- 3.0+ GPA
- 2026 or 2027 grad
- Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship
- Must be geographically mobile (rotations may require relocation)
- Start date: June 2027

Pay: $53K–$106K annually + benefits + short-term incentives

Apply here: https://jobs.carrier.com/en/job/palm-beach-gardens/digital-technology-leadership-program/29289/99681511568

Deadline: Applications close in ~3 days from September 2, 2026 — apply now.
